tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 5th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 5th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. You refuse to perform desire or creativity for approval; raw self-expression and appetite. Strong ambivalence about creativity and children, fierce desire set against fear, and a perfectionism that can paralyze. Freed, it pours out original, non-conforming work.
business: The disowned self activates through creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy. Unapologetic creative and romantic authenticity.
shadow: Drama and risk in love and play, or creativity locked away by shame.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 5th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and visible joy directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
